column1: One row per combatant. 'layers' is outermost-first and rotates as it takes hits. 'pool' is which abilities this unit may use. Add enemies by adding rows. `drops` is what BEATING this unit may leave, as kind:amount:chance - CRYSTAL:2:0.75|SEGMENT:3:0.55|ORB:1:0.40 means up to two crystals three quarters of the time, up to three Track Segments just over half, and a Stamina Orb (which gives back orbMsPct of MaxMS) two times in five. Each is rolled on its own, so an enemy can leave everything, something, or nothing. Blank means nothing ever.

column19: AI reads the matchups sheet, so retuning it retunes the AI. `drops` is what beating this one may leave.
